methodology: This catalogue follows the supplied source notes; their claims have not been independently verified.
Descriptions summarize the supplied unlock conditions. An undisclosed requirement remains undisclosed rather than receiving a guessed solution.
The source estimates about 28 hidden trophies without naming them. Our 28 hidden flags are editorial spoiler protection, not confirmed platform flags.
Positive Mental Attitude receives a precautionary missable flag. The notes do not establish whether the Chapter 1 invitation is mandatory.
The 54 listed numerical rewards total 1,000G. Platinum is represented by 0 points because its Mythic equivalent has no numerical reward specified.
Tier colors identify reward metals. No player rarity percentages are available.

references.title: gta.guide · GTA VI
references.note: The supplied document's trophy requirements and activity advice.

references.title: GTABase · Grand Theft Auto VI
references.note: The source attributes its roughly 200-hour estimate and lack of replay, difficulty selection and New Game+ to GTABase.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy and become a Leonida Legend.
guide: Complete all 54 prerequisite entries, including A Long Road's 100% target.
Use this Ledger for trophy-only tasks as well as the game's completion menu. The final checkmark is awarded automatically here.
trophies.caveat: The source's 200-hour estimate is approximate. The Mythic reward has no numerical G value supplied.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.description: Finish Gone Fishing in the opening chapter.
guide: Advance through Chapter 1 until Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission objectives. The notes describe this early story reward as unmissable.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.description: Complete the first story chapter.
guide: Play through the Chapter 1 storyline.
Continue into Chapter 2: the supplied trigger is completion of What's in the Bag?, rather than the chapter boundary itself.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.description: Finish Chapter 2 and enter the next chapter.
guide: Finish the second chapter's required missions.
Play Welcome to Vice City at the opening of Chapter 3 for the reported unlock. The trophy title keeps the source's masking.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.description: Bring Chapter 3 to a close.
guide: Finish Chapter 3's story arc.
Complete Ocean Beach and Another Life in Chapter 4. Both opening missions precede the reward according to the notes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.description: Finish the fourth story chapter.
guide: Keep following the main objectives through Chapter 4.
Complete the chapter; the source does not give an additional trigger or performance condition.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.description: See the story through its final mission.
guide: Reach the finale and finish the last main mission.
Once the credits end, use continued free roam to work on the unfinished collection.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.description: Complete Breakfast Run.
guide: Look for Breakfast Run during Chapter 2's main storyline.
Finish its objectives; the notes list no extra requirement for this trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.description: Pull off The Cartel Heist.
guide: Progress through Chapter 3 until The Cartel Heist is available.
Complete the mission to collect its story reward.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.description: Complete the Child's Play mission.
guide: Continue the fourth chapter to Child's Play.
Follow the mission through to completion; no separate medal target is supplied.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.description: Finish Headliners.
guide: Reach Headliners in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission's story objectives for the listed reward.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.description: Finish VCIA Takedown.
guide: Play Chapter 4 until VCIA Takedown.
Complete that mission. The source connects this reward to the mission, independently of the free-roam jet trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.description: Complete Operation Savage Glory.
guide: Advance Chapter 5 to Operation Savage Glory.
Finish the operation and its required objectives.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.description: Reach the game's 100% completion target.
guide: After the story, consult Progress → Stats → 100% Completion. Work performed earlier already contributes; the notes say this checklist has no missable requirements.
Complete all 8 vaults, all 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, 42 range golds, all 42 drone races and Bret's 15 hunting tasks.
Reach the partial targets as well: 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts and 200 scanned vehicle models.
Use the in-game checklist to identify remaining categories. The supplied document gives examples rather than a complete category inventory.
trophies.caveat: 100% completion and all trophies have different thresholds; finishing this requirement alone does not award platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.description: Complete any combination of 250 stunts.
guide: Combine jumps, bridge flights, knife-edge flying and base jumps toward 250 of the 397 available stunts.
The source recommends under-bridge flights for speed. Continue to 300 when pursuing 100% completion.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each of the nine activity types.
guide: Go fishing and hunting, play golf and pool, and visit a shooting range.
Make a basketball shot, play an arcade game, win a race and perform a stunt to cover the remaining four types.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn gold on every shooting-range challenge.
guide: Visit the 12 shooting ranges and work through their challenges.
Collect all 42 gold medals. Range practice also improves Focus and contributes to 100%.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a drone race at every Top Fun location.
guide: Visit each of the 14 Top Fun locations and win one drone race there.
For the larger completion goal, finish the full set of 42 races instead of stopping at one per location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.description: Win 20 distinct races.
guide: Choose separate events from the 40 races available.
Record wins in 20 different races. Repeating a previously won event does not increase this count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Meet Cal through Feng Shui in Chapter 1 and follow the fishing location he texts you.
Continue his fishing quests until the challenge, then win against him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.description: Finish any one arcade game.
guide: Choose Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the home television, or find a Bang For Your Buck cabinet.
Play the selected game through to completion; any one of the four qualifies.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Finish Andy's last mission.
guide: As Lucia in Chapter 3, answer Andy's message to begin his five-job chain.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and finally Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the last job for Kenton.
guide: Begin Kenton's Chapter 1 treasure work and visit seven wrecks at the purple markers.
Dive and use the metal detector to recover the treasures. Watch for his later message to complete the strand.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Finish Billy's final job.
guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, visit the Thrillbilly Mudclub to start Billy's jobs.
Complete all five, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete eight qualifying stranger mission strands.
guide: Follow stranger chains across Leonida. The supplied examples that count are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Check the trophy's in-game counter as you finish strands; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are listed as excluded.
trophies.caveat: The full qualifying list is still unconfirmed in the source. Do not assume every optional contact increases the counter.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete Randy's vehicle delivery strand.
guide: Scan vehicles with WAiNK to identify models requested on Randy's list.
Deliver all 16 sports cars to his garage in western Vice City and finish the strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete Tyrone's last mission.
guide: Use Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 to begin Tyrone's work.
Destroy the synthetic labs around Vice City, then complete Shut Down the Labs.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate throughout Leonida until the counter reaches 18.
guide: The morning after Down to Earth in Chapter 1, accept Lucia's invitation to meditate on the balcony.
Visit the remaining meditation spots. A joint session with Jason and Lucia counts twice; reach 18 on the trophy counter.
The 100% checklist needs only 15 meditations, so check the trophy counter separately.
trophies.caveat: Potentially missable: the source has not confirmed that the early balcony session is required. Taking the invitation preserves the reported opportunity.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Start Bret's hunting work after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Work through his unique-animal jobs. All 15 tasks are needed for 100% completion anyway.
trophies.caveat: The notes do not identify which animal triggers this trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.description: Finish three collectible card sets.
guide: Use Progress → Collections to see which card sets are close to completion.
Collect every card in any three sets; no particular trio is specified.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.description: Record 100 locations using WAiNK It.
guide: Use WAiNK It on landmarks, sculptures, oddities and No Flusher graffiti during your travels.
Register any 100 qualifying locations to reach the target.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.description: Complete 50 challenges.
guide: Work through the available pool of 80 challenges, including those completed naturally during play.
Finish 50 for this reward, then keep going to 70 for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Escape a four-star wanted level with your partner.
guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, call your partner and build a four-star wanted level together.
Escape beyond the red zone. A bank vault robbery supplies the required wanted level, making it a useful combined objective.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob three stores with your partner during one continuous wanted level.
guide: Bring your partner and plan a route between three stores; the source suggests northern Vice City's three jewelry stores.
Rob all three without dropping your wanted level. Allow about 30 seconds for the reported notification delay.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.description: Scan 100 different vehicle models with WAiNK.
guide: Stand near a busy road and scan new models as traffic passes; stealing them is unnecessary.
Reach 100 distinct models for this trophy, or 200 toward the full completion checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Defeat five enemies in a single Combat Focus activation.
guide: Fill Focus before the encounter and equip an assault rifle, as recommended by the source.
Choose a group such as gang-operation enemies, activate Combat Focus once and defeat five before the effect expires.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unauthorized departure from VCIA.
guide: Find and steal a large passenger jet parked beside a gate's jet bridge at VCIA.
Take off and travel roughly one kilometer away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.description: Defeat enemies using a stolen tank.
guide: Go to Mile Zero Air Station on the southwestern island of Mariana County.
Look along the base's southern edge for tanks, steal one and use it against enemies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Complete Yasmani's Chapter 3 missions to obtain the Snap Gun.
Use it on a jewelry store's rear door and look in the storeroom for the safe-code note while maintaining stealth.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.description: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time.
guide: Unlock vault robberies through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
Rob five vaults and get away. Bring a partner if you want to split the loot; finish all eight for 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an armored truck and make your escape.
guide: Attack an armored truck; the notes suggest using a sticky bomb.
Take the robbery through to a successful escape. The source also says escaping after a bank vault robbery can satisfy this reward.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.description: Uncover the whole Leonida map.
guide: Explore until no map fog remains across the state.
Use a plane to cover large unexplored areas quickly, then inspect the map for missed patches.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an illegal operation from every gang.
guide: Track which gangs you have targeted and complete at least one operation for each of the nine gangs.
For 100% completion, clear the full collection of 39 gang operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach.
guide: The supplied condition calls for a cocktail with an Ocean Beach view.
Keep this entry for a later check against the game's trophy information; the notes provide no verified interaction sequence.
trophies.caveat: The exact location and steps are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Drive a showroom car out through its display window.
guide: The source describes taking a car through a vehicle showroom's glass display.
Use the listed action as the objective; no specific showroom or confirmed sequence is supplied.
trophies.caveat: The notes have not confirmed the detailed unlock method.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Rob the Port Gellhorn bowling venue and evade police.
guide: The walkthrough identifies Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn as the robbery site.
Take the watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun and the safe, then lose the police.
trophies.caveat: The supplied description instead names Kolt & Associates. That venue-name conflict is unresolved.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.description: Maximize Strength for both protagonists.
guide: Take your partner to fitness clubs and train together.
Keep training until both characters' Strength is full. The notes say training one partner boosts the other too.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.description: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
guide: Continue normal play while actions that influence the Criminal Profile accumulate toward 500.
Watch your profile status: the notes say reaching Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid forcing that state just to increase the count.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.description: Requirement undisclosed; the supplied hint is “Second time's the charm.”
guide: The notes supply the hint Second time's the charm without an unlock condition.
Leave this unchecked until it unlocks or the game's description establishes the requirement.
trophies.caveat: No confirmed method is available in the supplied source.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.description: Requirement undisclosed; the supplied hint asks “What the hell just happened?”
guide: The supplied text gives only the hint What the hell just happened?.
Check the game's trophy information when available. There is no supported route to prescribe from these notes.
trophies.caveat: Both the unlock condition and the method remain unknown.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Perform the melee drive-by suggested by the supplied description.
guide: The description points toward a melee drive-by with the phrase Bowl 'em over.
Treat that wording as a clue. The notes do not specify a vehicle, weapon, target count or confirmed sequence.
trophies.caveat: A precise unlock method has not been confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn a cumulative $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through contacts.
guide: Obtain the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3, then collect Marked Bills from banks and Payday Loans.
Sell the bills to fences until earnings reach $250,000 across transactions. Yasmani is listed as the highest-paying contact.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.description: Spend $100,000 in stores over time.
guide: Let purchases across stores accumulate toward the $100,000 total.
The source recommends weapons, vehicle modifications and tattoos as quick ways to spend the required amount.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.description: Purchase all eight available garages.
guide: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to access the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy its eight garages, budgeting about $160,000 in total. The four story-provided garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register ten vehicles through Scooter Bros.
guide: Unlock the Scooter Bros app through Moses's Chapter 2 mission and take stolen vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage.
Keep garage space free and pay to register ten vehicles. Cheap cars and bikes help contain the cost.
